test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Convert to direct speech: **The professor remarked that students needed to submit their papers before Friday.

options.text: “Students need to submit their papers before Friday,” the professor remarked.
“Students needed to submit their papers before Friday,” said the professor.
“Submit your papers before Friday,” the professor instructed.
“You were to submit your papers before Friday,” said the professor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The professor remarked that students needed to submit their papers before Friday.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"students needed to submit" becomes "students need to submit"**
 
 
• The verb "needed" is converted to "need" to match present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"before Friday" remains unchanged.**
 
 
• The time frame remains consistent when converting to direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "remarked that"
 
• Converted to: "remarked," maintaining the reporting tone.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Students" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Students need to submit their papers before Friday,” the professor remarked."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Students needed to submit their papers before Friday," said the professor.

 
 
• The verb "needed" remains in past tense, which does not match the correct direct speech conversion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Submit your papers before Friday," the professor instructed.
 
 
• Changes the tone to an instruction rather than a remark.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "You were to submit your papers before Friday," said the professor.
 
 
• Incorrect tense "were to submit" changes the meaning and context.
